title: Henry B. Plant Museum
scope: The former Tampa Bay Hotel, now H. B. Plant Hall and the Henry B. Plant Museum, including its mapped wings, park and railroad entries, verandas and Moorish roof structures.
limitations: Scope covers the present standing hotel building at the mapped Plant Hall footprint. Detached park structures are outside scope.
Door and window pattern counts on less photographed sides, smaller cupola positions and minor roof heights are approximate.
